summary: Router 0.42.15 closes TM-14's 'fuller unit directive set' (ADR-0138, proposed). router/skirnir-router.service adds ProtectKernelLogs, ProtectClock, ProtectHostname, PrivateDevices, RestrictNamespaces, RestrictRealtime, RemoveIPC, ProtectProc=invisible, ProcSubset=pid, RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_NETLINK, SystemCallFilter=@system-service, SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM; existing directives unchanged. Checked what the router needs: it reads /proc/self only (process_view.py), opens AF_INET UDP for Wake-on-LAN (wol.py) and TCP/TLS for everything else, no devices, raw or packet sockets. Proven at runtime: the new test/unit_hardening_check.sh builds a throwaway Debian 13 image (systemd 257) and runs the real install.sh, starts the router under the unit with TLS and checks API, model list, chat without node, UI, admin state, a configuration write into the state folder and a reload, failing on journal lines that look like refused calls or files: passed with the new unit (exposure 1.5 instead of 4.9 for the previous unit, measured the same way), failed with a deliberately too narrow RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX. The check runs a privileged container on the developer's machine only (not CI, no credentials; synthetic password/token, example domain). AGENTS.md (a rules file) gains the command and the rule to run it for unit changes: flagged for maintainer review. MemoryDenyWriteExecute and a tighter syscall list were deliberately left out (documented).

tests.evidence: install.sh STATE installed; service active; API version 200 over TLS; /api/tags 200; chat without node 503; UI 200; admin state 200; PUT /admin/config 200 and roles.yaml in /var/lib/skirnir-router; reload active 200; journal without refused calls or files; exposure 1.5 (previous unit 4.9). Rejected case: with RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX the check fails (tracebacks, STATE failed).
12 new checks, one per directive; with the previous unit file 12 failures.

tests.command: every python test/... and tools/... command of all workflows in .github/workflows/, except run_tests.py and check_public_changes (run separately); plus ruff check ., router.py --check and bash -n of the new scripts
tests.evidence: 99 commands, 0 failed; includes selftest_install and selftest_security (unit checks).
run after staging this record; synthetic test password and token, router.example.net.

limitations: The runtime check ran on Debian 13 / systemd 257 only; an older systemd ignores directives it does not know.
Not in CI (needs a privileged container); AGENTS.md asks for it on unit changes.
Paths not exercised in the check: MQTT, PostgreSQL/SQLite session store, Hindsight, cloud egress, agent tunnel; they use the same socket families and ordinary file calls.
